> We tried to register Stripe Solutions in your Ivalua portal this morning but hit an error during the final step ("Email already associated with another account" + 403).

Sorry for the friction — that error usually means either a pre-existing placeholder entry or an SSO/email collision from a previous trial account. I copied Ben (procurement ops) and Laura (vendor onboarding) to help provision a manual account if needed.

Next steps (proposed):
- Natalie: please reply with your legal entity name and DUNS (or VAT/Business ID) and attach W-9 (or local tax form) + bank remittance template.
- Ben: can you see if there is an overlapping entry for natalie.cruz@stripesol.com and, if so, convert/delete the duplicate and create an invited vendor record? If manual creation is required, please provision a placeholder and share the invitation link.
- Laura: please add this vendor to the upcoming PO onboarding checklist and confirm required PO payment terms.

I'll also open an internal ticket with Ivalua support if we hit a dead end — linking it here: https://ivalua.example.com/admin/tickets/INC-7412

I've attached a short procurement-kickoff checklist to speed things up. If you can send the documents by end of day Monday, we should be able to get you into the system before the onboarding kickoff.

Best,
Olga Petrov
